{"tools":[
{"name":"create_journal_entry","description":"Posts a manual double-entry journal entry to the general ledger with two or more debit and credit lines. Use for adjustments, accruals, or transactions that have no dedicated tool; debits must equal credits.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"date":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"Posting date (YYYY-MM-DD)"},"memo":{"type":"string","description":"Description of the entry"},"lines":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"account_code":{"type":"string"},"debit":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"credit":{"type":"number","minimum":0}},"required":["account_code"]}},"reference":{"type":"string","description":"Optional external reference such as a document number"}},"required":["date","memo","lines"]},"request":"Post a journal entry dated 31 March that moves $1,200 of prepaid insurance (account 1400) into insurance expense (account 6200)."},
{"name":"list_ledger_entries","description":"Returns general ledger transactions filtered by account, date range, and optional amount or text search. Use to audit or investigate postings.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"account_code":{"type":"string"},"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"min_amount":{"type":"number"},"search_text":{"type":"string","description":"Match against memo or reference"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":100},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"Show me every ledger posting to the Shipping Supplies account (5120) between January 1 and January 31."},
{"name":"get_account_balance","description":"Returns the balance of a single ledger account as of a given date, with total debits and credits. Use for a quick point-in-time balance check.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"account_code":{"type":"string"},"as_of_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"required":["account_code"]},"request":"What was the balance of our Accounts Payable account (2000) as of the end of last month, 30 June?"},
{"name":"list_chart_of_accounts","description":"Lists accounts in the chart of accounts with code, name, type, and active status. Use to find the right account code before posting or categorizing.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"account_type":{"type":"string","enum":["asset","liability","equity","revenue","expense"]},"include_inactive":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"name_contains":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Which expense accounts do we have in the chart of accounts that have 'vehicle' in the name?"},
{"name":"reverse_journal_entry","description":"Reverses a previously posted journal entry by creating an offsetting entry, keeping the audit trail intact. Use to correct a mistaken posting rather than deleting it.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"journal_entry_id":{"type":"string"},"reversal_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["journal_entry_id","reason"]},"request":"Journal entry JE-20418 was posted to the wrong month, so please reverse it with the reason 'wrong period'."},
{"name":"record_expense","description":"Records a business expense paid to a vendor, with amount, category, payment method, and date. Use when a shop manager reports a purchase or bill that should hit the books.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"vendor":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0},"currency":{"type":"string","default":"USD"},"date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"category":{"type":"string","description":"Expense category, e.g. rent, utilities, supplies"},"payment_method":{"type":"string","enum":["cash","card","bank_transfer","check"]},"tax_amount":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"notes":{"type":"string"}},"required":["vendor","amount","date","category","payment_method"]},"request":"Log a $186.40 card payment to Staples today for printer paper and toner under office supplies."},
{"name":"list_expenses","description":"Lists recorded expenses with filters for date range, category, vendor, and payment method, plus a total. Use to review or look up spending.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"category":{"type":"string"},"vendor":{"type":"string"},"payment_method":{"type":"string","enum":["cash","card","bank_transfer","check"]},"limit":{"type":"integer","default":50},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"List everything we spent with Sysco in May so I can check it against their statement."},
{"name":"categorize_expense","description":"Changes the category (and the matching ledger account) of an existing expense. Use to fix miscategorized spending.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"expense_id":{"type":"string"},"new_category":{"type":"string"},"note":{"type":"string"}},"required":["expense_id","new_category"]},"request":"Expense EXP-3392 should be under 'repairs and maintenance' and not 'office supplies'. Please change it."},
{"name":"attach_receipt_to_expense","description":"Attaches a receipt image or PDF URL to an existing expense record for audit and tax documentation.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"expense_id":{"type":"string"},"receipt_url":{"type":"string","format":"uri"},"file_name":{"type":"string"}},"required":["expense_id","receipt_url"]},"request":"Attach the receipt at https://files.myshop.example/receipts/hvac-0612.pdf to expense EXP-3410."},
{"name":"record_customer_refund","description":"Books the accounting side of a customer refund: reduces revenue, adjusts sales tax payable, and credits cash or card clearing. It does not move money to the customer, so use it to keep the ledger in sync after a refund is issued.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_reference":{"type":"string"},"refund_amount":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0},"tax_refunded":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":0},"refund_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"refund_method":{"type":"string","enum":["card","cash","store_credit","bank_transfer"]},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["order_reference","refund_amount","refund_date","refund_method"]},"request":"We already refunded order 88213 for $54.00 ($4.32 of it was tax) to the customer's card yesterday, so please book it in the accounting records."},
{"name":"post_order_revenue","description":"Posts revenue for a completed sales order to the ledger, splitting product revenue, shipping income, discounts, and sales tax collected. Use when an order needs to be recognized in the books.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_reference":{"type":"string"},"order_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"subtotal":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"shipping_charged":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":0},"discount_total":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":0},"sales_tax_collected":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"default":0},"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"payment_status":{"type":"string","enum":["paid","unpaid"]}},"required":["order_reference","order_date","subtotal","payment_status"]},"request":"Recognize revenue for order 90417 placed on 5 May: $320 subtotal, $12 shipping, $20 discount, $26.40 sales tax, paid in full."},
{"name":"calculate_sales_tax","description":"Calculates the sales tax or VAT due on an amount for a given jurisdiction and product tax category, without posting anything. Use for quotes or checking rates.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0},"jurisdiction":{"type":"string","description":"Region code, e.g. US-CA or DE"},"product_tax_category":{"type":"string","enum":["general","food","clothing","digital","exempt"],"default":"general"},"prices_include_tax":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["amount","jurisdiction"]},"request":"How much sales tax should I charge on a $480 clothing sale shipped to Oregon versus Washington state? Start with Washington."},
{"name":"get_tax_liability_summary","description":"Summarizes the tax currently owed (collected minus paid and input credits) per tax type for a period, with due dates. Use to know how much to set aside for the next payment.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"period_start":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"period_end":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"tax_type":{"type":"string","enum":["sales_tax","vat","payroll_tax","income_tax"]}},"required":["period_start","period_end"]},"request":"How much sales tax do we currently owe for the third quarter, July through September?"},
{"name":"export_sales_tax_report","description":"Generates a downloadable sales tax filing report broken down by jurisdiction, with taxable sales, exempt sales, and tax collected. Use when preparing a return.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"period_start":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"period_end":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"format":{"type":"string","enum":["csv","pdf","xlsx"],"default":"pdf"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["jurisdiction","tax_rate","month"],"default":"jurisdiction"}},"required":["period_start","period_end"]},"request":"Export a CSV sales tax report by jurisdiction for Q2 so my accountant can file the return."},
{"name":"generate_profit_and_loss_report","description":"Produces a profit and loss statement for a date range, showing revenue, cost of goods sold, gross profit, operating expenses, and net income. Use for a single-period income view.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"basis":{"type":"string","enum":["accrual","cash"],"default":"accrual"},"breakdown":{"type":"string","enum":["none","monthly","quarterly"],"default":"none"}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"Give me the profit and loss statement for last year on a cash basis, broken down by month."},
{"name":"compare_profit_and_loss_periods","description":"Compares net income and each P&L line between two periods and returns dollar and percentage changes. Use to see what drove profit up or down.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"current_start":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"current_end":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"previous_start":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"previous_end":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"top_n_changes":{"type":"integer","default":10}},"required":["current_start","current_end","previous_start","previous_end"]},"request":"Compare our profit this November against last November and show which lines changed the most."},
{"name":"create_budget","description":"Creates a budget for a fiscal period with planned amounts per account or category. Use when starting a new monthly, quarterly, or annual budget.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"period_start":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"period_end":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"lines":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"category":{"type":"string"},"planned_amount":{"type":"number","minimum":0}},"required":["category","planned_amount"]}}},"required":["name","period_start","period_end","lines"]},"request":"Set up a budget called 'Holiday Season' for 1 Nov to 31 Dec with $8,000 for advertising, $15,000 for inventory, and $4,500 for temp staff."},
{"name":"get_budget_vs_actual","description":"Compares planned budget amounts with actual spending per category for a budget, showing variance and percent used. Use to check if you are overspending.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"budget_id":{"type":"string"},"as_of_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"only_over_budget":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["budget_id"]},"request":"Which categories in budget BUD-2024-Q3 are already over their limit?"},
{"name":"update_budget_line","description":"Changes the planned amount of one category in an existing budget. Use to reallocate or adjust a budget mid-period.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"budget_id":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string"},"new_planned_amount":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["budget_id","category","new_planned_amount"]},"request":"Raise the advertising line in budget BUD-2024-Q4 to $10,000 because we are adding a Black Friday campaign."},
{"name":"get_customer_balance","description":"Returns a customer's accounts receivable position: open invoices, overdue amounts, unapplied credits, and net balance owed. Use to see what a specific customer owes the business.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"as_of_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"include_paid_invoices":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["customer_id"]},"request":"How much does customer CUST-1187 (Harbor Café) currently owe us, and how much of it is overdue?"}
]}
